notes.title: DEV LOG 5: AUGUST ADVANCE IS HERE! (+ MANY OTHER CHANGES/ADDITIONS)
notes.content:
A new update is here, and this one's a doozy! 

Not only do we have our last wave of new Pixelitos, but we have a new seasonal event mode, and various fun new gameplay updates!

First off, the new seasonal event for August is known as August Advance! In this mode, Pixelitos no longer move in turns, but rather, move in realtime based on their respective speed stats! Many players have voiced concerns over the speed stat, and have shared many interesting suggestions, so August Advance aims to try some of these ideas out! Naturally, since this mode completely flips the game upside down, we suspect there may be some bugs or unintended balance issues, so please share any and all of your findings!

In addition, a new feature has been added to the D-L-C Dungeons: Void Effects!
Every 5 rounds, the dungeons will shift, and a random Void Effect will be applied to the player's shop/team! These effects can range from changing stats, to putting rare items in the shop, to completely changing the nature of Pixelitos that aren't possible in the base game! Be warned, not all Void Effects are good, so always stay on your toes in the Dungeon.

And as always, please let me share the latest Pixelitos! 


 Pebbuin (by @Tsunderella) - Pixelito Boosted: Send % of Boost to Other Team
 Pipepede (by @DrewTwoBlue) - Ally Swaps: Summon Pipe on Swap Positions, Dealing 5,10,15 Damage to Adjacent Tiles
 Cannibud (by @Dr.Pectoral) - Faint: Attacker Loses % of Remaining HP


This will be the last new set of Pixelitos for now. 
With these new additions, hopefully you will be able to find a new level of creativity in your teambuilding!

There have also been various balance changes to improve the battling experience for everyone. 
For details, please see the full Changelog.

notes.title: DEV LOG 4: ENTER THE D-L-C DUNGEONS WITH THESE NEW PIXELITOS!
notes.content:
July is over, and with it, its time to say goodbye to July Joust! I will share the results of the July Joust questionnaire in the next Dev Log. Hopefully by then, I can introduce the next Event Mode, which I'm excited to share with everyone. 

But before that, we have a new Game Mode! Say hello to the D-L-C Dungeon! This is an endless randomized dungeon featuring dungeon bosses (taken from the pool of recent community Pixelitos!). This is a fun way to experience the new Pixelitos in a single-player capacity. To access it, you must have at least 3 badges in Story Mode. The mode is currently relatively easy, so all you badge-chasers better get your new badge now, before I make it harder next update!

Anyway, onto the new Pixelitos! 

From Left to Right

 Spectralamb (by @Tsunderella) - Faint: Haunt Attacker, Spawn Ghost Form if Attacker Knocked Out
 Pirooette (by @DrewTwoBlue) - Attack: Swap Opponent with Nearest Opponent Weak to It
 Slungus (by @Le Duelist) - Hurt: Release Spores, Causing Opponent to Target Allies for 1 Turn


With many of these new Pixelitos, their abilities change the game in drastic ways, and they may seem even "broken" at the moment. But in order to see where balance really lies, its best to let the players test out the extremities of each Pixelito. So give em a whirl, and please share your feedback.

Since this was a pretty meaty update that required changing a lot of core-level code, please let me know if you face any unexpected bugs/issues. 

Next update will feature the last new Community Pixelitos (for now), but please continue to share your ideas, and we'll try to find the right fit for them!

notes.title: DEV LOG 3: NEW PIXELITOS, NEW ITEMS, AND MUCH NEEDED BALANCE CHANGES
notes.content:
I expected to have the Story Mode integration for the new Pixelitos ready by now, but as always, life gives you other priorities. Hopefully it won't be too long now; I think people will enjoy it.

But it's that time of the week again! The next round of new Pixelitos are here! 
And with them, a couple changes people might have been waiting for...

From Left to Right

 Bouzoom (by @Marceline) - Ally Faints: Repeat Ally's "On-Faint" Ability
 Nymflute (by @DrewTwoBlue) - Opponent Combos: Give Random Ally 5 Attack
 Fauxmeleon (by @infitros) - Battle Start: Copy Opposing Pixelito


In addition to these new Pixelitos, we also have a new item, Natt-Ouch!, which should allow players some more teambuilding creative range.

Lastly, several changes have been made to improve the overall balance of the game. 
Some of the changes may seem obvious at first glance, but outside of just "make this Pixelito weaker", one of the main adjustments in this update is to further facilitate the Position-Based nature of the game. With 3x2 Formations becoming standardized, Pixelito position is more important than ever, so narrowing the scope of abilities to rely on positioning is an important game-philosophy alignment in my opinion.
Of course, we will continue to monitor the weight of every Pixelito as these changes settle in.

For full details, please see the Version 1.2.11 Patch Notes.

And as always, keep those Pixelito ideas comin'!

I have been reading people's feedback for the July Joust questionnaire, and its clear that a rousing majority is in favor of making the 3x2 format permanent! As we move into August, I will gradually work to bring these changes to the main game.

In more important news though, with the help of the community, I would like to introduce our first new batch of Pixelitos since the game's release!

These Pixelitos are only the first in an upcoming new set, and as such, should be treated as incomplete experimental Pixelitos. They are available in-game now, but you are not required to use them or face them in game yet, and can disable Experimental Pixelitos in the main menu before starting Online Battles.

A new Story Mode segment is currently planned to help introduce Experimental Pixelitos, so stay tuned...

And as a reminder, we still have many Pixelitos to create, so keep your ideas coming! Whether its illustrations, ability concepts, or just fun pun names, all community input is welcome.

notes.title: DEV LOG 1: CALLING ALL PIXELITO DESIGNERS
notes.content:
Over the past few weeks, players have shared tons of valuable feedback about the current gameloop. And it obviously has a lot of changing to do. I hope that the July Joust has helped mitigate some of the concerns over the randomness of team placement. Later this week, I plan to include a questionnaire in-game to allow players to share their thoughts on this new mode.
However, I also think that a consequence of an autobattler is that critical players may get caught up in analyzing the battles, when in reality, the heart of the game lies in the shop. Originally when I made the shop, I was worried that players would have little agency in making their teams, so I added items like Toprika or Friennel to push back against the RNG. Almost a year later, and now I see that its actually the opposite problem:

 Players can make any team they want in any run, and that's bad

In a game like this, strategy is about being clever enough to make a strong team with the limited tools provided, and currently Pixelitos' shop is a little too unlimited. That's why, over the next several weeks, I plan to introduce a New Wave of Pixelitos. The main reasons for this is to achieve the following:

 Add variance to the shop, forcing players to improvise more in teambuilding
 Introduce new abilities that allow for a wider variety of strategies
 Encourage replayability, so that Pixelitos not obtained in one run may allow players to consider them in a future one


For now, these will be treated as an experimental set, and exclusive to event modes. 

FOR PLAYERS: This is where you come in! Since we are adding new Pixelitos, I encourage everyone to share your ideas. Feel free to share here in the Suggestions Forum, or on the Discord server. I cannot guarantee every idea will get in, but the best ideas will be credited in-game as your Pixelito. Keep in mind that we won't be adding new types (yet), so keep it to the current 7.
I can't wait to see everyone's ideas.
